## World Bank data

The downloadable example uses the same two-step API as the Quickstart.

```{python}
#| eval: false
import paneltime as pt
import loadwb

data = loadwb.load_worldbank_data()
data = data[data["Inflation"].abs() < 30]
model = pt.PanelARIMAGARCH(
    "Inflation ~ L(Gross_Savings) + L(Inflation) + L(Interest_rate)",
    data,
    entity="country",
    time="date",
)
results = model.fit(order=(2, 2, 1), garch_order=(2, 2), vol="EGARCH")
print(results.summary())
```
